description.html: What are muscle recovery supplements? They are supplements designed to help your muscles recover and refuel from damage done during workouts. There are many types of recovery supplements from those that help you get better sleep to those that feed your muscles the nutrients necessary for continued growth. What are the benefits of muscle recovery supplements? In order for your muscles to grow you need to damage them. The quicker your body can repair the damage the more your muscles will grow. Athletes using recovery supplements experience reduced muscle soreness, and improved recovery times.. Who should use them? Everybody can benefit from muscle recovery supplements like BCAA’s, protein, L-carnitine, creatine and more. FAQs Q Will a fat loss supplement work if I don’t change what I eat? A No. They are designed to be just that, a supplement. They may enhance your body’s ability to burn fat but nothing can take the place of healthy eating and exercise. Q What is the best time to take a fat loss supplement? A That depends. If it contains stimulants the best time is take it in the morning so it won’t affect your sleep. Q Can fat loss supplements interact with medications? A Maybe. Every fat loss supplement can contain a variety of ingredients so an interaction is possible. That’s why it’s important to consult your doctor if you’re considering taking a fat loss supplement.

What are fat loss supplements? Dietary supplements promoted for fat loss encompass a wide variety of products and come in a variety of forms, including capsules, tablets, liquids, powders, and bars. What do fat loss supplements do? They are designed to enhance your body’s ability to maximize fat loss and absorb more nutrients from your food. Who can use fat loss supplements? Anyone looking to burn fat and lose weight, but always talk to your doctor to discuss potential risks and benefits on a personal basis. This is especially important if you have high blood pressure, diabetes, heart disease, liver disease, are pregnant or breast feeding, or have other medical conditions. FAQs Q Will a fat loss supplement work if I don’t change what I eat? A No. They are designed to be just that, a supplement. They may enhance your body’s ability to burn fat but nothing can take the place of healthy eating and exercise. Q What is the best time to take a fat loss supplement? A That depends. If it contains stimulants the best time is take it in the morning so it won’t affect your sleep. Q Can fat loss supplements interact with medications? A Maybe. Every fat loss supplement can contain a variety of ingredients so an interaction is possible. That’s why it’s important to consult your doctor if you’re considering taking a fat loss supplement.

What are Fat burner supplements? Fat burners a category of supplements that are designed to increase your body’s fat burning potential and energy expenditure, impede fat absorption, and speed fat loss. What are the benefits of fat burners? Fat burners help to enhance fat loss, boost energy, curb appetite and help your body burn more calories throughout the day. Who should use them? Anyone who is healthy and wants to get rid of stubborn belly fat. If you have been stuck at a plateau and are looking for something to melt the last bit of fat off your frame then this could be a simple addition that makes a huge difference for you. FAQs Q Can I eat whatever I want and see results using fat burners? A No. They aren’t magic pills. However, when combined with healthy food choices and regular exercise they can enhance your body’s fat loss and fat burning potential and you can see incredible results. Q How much extra weight could I lose using a fat burner? A Everyone is different and the results may vary for you as an individual, but the most effective way to utilize a fat burning supplement is to combine it with a rigorous exercise program and healthy eating. Q When is the best time of day to take a fat burner? A Because fat burners are stimulants they are best taken in the morning, this way your sleep won’t be affected from taking stimulants too close to bed time.

description.html: Description Product FAQ Product Ingredients OMNI is the embodiment of what speaks to YOUR VIBE. The art tells a story and the flavors transport you there. Whether you're powering through a hard day at work, embarking on an adrenaline-fueled adventure, or simply seeking a revitalizing pick-me-up during a busy day, OMNI will energize you from the inside out to help you push past your limits, and embrace every moment of your day with unparalleled vigor.Each single flavor pack includes 12, 12oz. cans, the variety pack includes 4 cans of each flavor (12, 12oz. cans.) Beach Day: A sunrise on the beach is imbued with a different energy. Life begins as the sun breaks the horizon, shining on the waves, transforming the colors of the sky, as the sand absorbs its warmth. Being a part of this phenomenon fuels inspiration, hopefulness, and reminds us that today is a fresh start. For days you can't make it to the beach, open a can of OMNI and Vibe High.Stoked: There is an indescribable feeling when you catch the perfect wave. An undeniable synchronization between person and nature occurs, followed shortly by pure adrenaline and joy. Just as important as the thrill of the wave is having the courage to chase after it, and leave nothing behind when you find it. OMNI is about the chase; seeking the ultimate freedom and never shying away from it. Grab a can, and drop in.Corsa: Life comes at you fast, and doesn’t slow itself down. Revving through hairpin turns, staying on-track through chicanes and unexpected roadblocks, taking control often proves difficult. OMNI is the opportunity to put yourself in the driver's seat and set the pace. Crisp, clean flavors infused with smooth-riding energy & life-enhancing ingredients put you in control for the perfect podium finish. Island Gold: In a pirate’s paradise the gulf breeze sings,Among palms & sand where beauty springs,A princess spurned, his advances denied,Her bitter spirit haunts like the red tide,On this isle where legends sway,She stands watch o’er gold that grows all day Pineapple|MK2: Pull the pin on a tired afternoon with the explosive tropical flavor of Pineapple MK2. This flavor is mission-ready to ration our signature OMNI Energy blend, supplying you with energy, electrolytes, and b-vitamins.Georgia: A sweet miracle that soaks in the sun, flourishing into a juicy & refreshing experience. Take a sip and get whisked away to an orchard at peak-season, feeling the sun on your skin with a can of Georgia. Are there age restrictions for Omni Energy? Generally, we do not recommend this product for individuals under the age of 18. Is this product safe for pregnant women? Omni Energy is not recommended for women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. Can Omni be used as a pre-workout? OMNI may be used for pre-workout purposes. Each can provides 200mg of caffeine, 135mg of electrolytes, and 25mg of soothing L-Theanine. What are all of the Omni ingredients? Carbonated Water, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Caffeine, Potassium Sorbate (Preservative), Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Sucralose, Ginger Extract, Acesulfame Potassium, Potassium Citrate, Natural Flavor, L-Theanine, Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), Pyridoxine HCl (Vitamin B6), Folic Acid, Biotin, Vitamin B12. *Ingredient order may vary depending on flavor. What is the purpose of each active ingredient in the Omni Active Energy Blend? Caffeine - 200mg Active 200mg is roughly equivalent to 2–2.5 cups of coffee. The caffeine experience is smoother because it is paired with L-Theanine. This amount is designed to help you feel awake, focused, and present without excessive stimulation or anxiety. L-Theanine - 25mg Active Our caffeine-to-L-Theanine ratio is 8:1, which helps modulate the effects of caffeine. The result is a smoother and more relaxed energy experience compared to a typical energy drink or multiple cups of coffee. Ginger Root Extract - 5mg Active Ginger Root Extract helps support digestion and may reduce the feeling of bloating often associated with carbonated beverages. Caffeine - 200mg Active 200mg is roughly equivalent to 2–2.5 cups of coffee. The caffeine content at 200mg provides strong energy while pairing with the stimulant-modulating effects of L-Theanine. This amount is designed to help you feel awake, focused, and present without excessive stimulation or anxiety. Vitamin C - 90mg Active Every can of OMNI provides 100% of the Daily Value (DV) for Vitamin C to support immune health. Electrolytes - 135mg Active OMNI contains 135mg of electrolytes to support whole-body hydration and help replenish minerals that may be lost through sweat. L-Theanine - 25mg Active L-Theanine is an amino acid best known for its calming effects and is naturally found in tea leaves. It is the compound largely responsible for the smooth energy commonly associated with green tea. L-Theanine acts as a governor for caffeine by helping regulate how strongly caffeine stimulates the body over time. While it does not cancel out caffeine, it can help reduce the intensity of caffeine's stimulant effects, resulting in a smoother and more balanced energy experience. Ginger Root Extract - 5mg Active Ginger Root Extract may help relieve digestive discomfort caused by carbonation, promoting a smoother drinking experience and helping reduce bloating.

description.html: What are "Pre-Workout" supplements? Pre-workouts explained: Everything you need to know before you hit the gym With bodybuilders, runners, and everyone in between looking for every training advantage they can get, the demand for cutting edge products continues to grow. In years past the only option athletes could utilize to get more out of their workouts was coffee, but today that has all changed because pre-workouts have become the go-to drink of choice for anyone looking to squeeze more out of their workouts. What are "Pre-Workout" supplements? Pre-Workout supplements such as creatine, amino-acids, caffeine, nitric oxide agents, and more. They generally come in powder form to be mixed as a delicious drink but many are also sold in pill form. Thanks to improvements in science todays pre-workouts can be fine tuned to achieve a wide variety of incredible physical and mental boosting results. The benefits of "Pre-workout supplements" In addition to improving VO2 max, pre-workouts have been shown to improve strength, focus, endurance, and mood. Who should use them? Healthy adults over 18 should be able to tolerate most pre-workouts well and see improvements in their athletic performance. However, pre-workouts aren’t for everyone. Those who are sensitive to caffeine or other stimulants may not tolerate pre-workouts well, especially if taken too late in the day. FAQs Q Can you stack pre-workouts? A Yes, but not with other stimulant based products. Our pre-workouts can be combined with ADABOLIC, Andro’s, ATP-Fusion. Q When should I take my pre-workout? A Take them 20 to 30 minutes before you exercise to see maximum benefits. Q Will pre-workouts affect my sleep? A While everyone reacts differently, it’s advised to avoid taking a pre-workout 6-8 hours before you go to sleep. Q Will they make me jittery? A Any pre-workout has the potential to make you jittery, but it really depends on how well you tolerate stimulants. We recommend you start with a 1/4 scoop to assess your tolerance.

Backed by Science to Help Optimize: • Stimulant Free Pre-Workout* • Muscle Hydrator* • Extreme Muscle Fullness* • Increases Endurance* Suggested use - How do I take Pumped-AF? Take 1 scoop with 8oz of water (for flavor) or 16oz of water to maximize the performance benefits of Pumped-AF, 20–30 minutes before training. What is Pumped? Pumped is a stimulant-free performance and recovery aid that does much more than increase pumps. It also functions as an endurance aid that supports both performance and aesthetic enhancement. What is Lavaburst supposed to taste like? A fusion between an orange and red iced slush. Can I take Pumped with my pre-workout? Yes, you can. You can also take Pumped by itself. How does Pumped work and what does it actually do? Pumped super-hydrates the muscles, which greatly increases endurance and workout capacity. This increase in hydration also helps muscles look and feel fuller while speeding up recovery. Do I really need a lot of water when using Pumped? Yes. Pumped pulls surface water into the muscles, so staying hydrated is vital to maximize its effects. For most users, 16oz of water before, during, and after training is ideal. Can Pumped be combined with other Steel products? Pumped can be combined with ANY STEEL product. Does Pumped contain any stimulants? Pumped contains zero stimulants. Can women take Pumped? Absolutely! Women should start with 1/2 scoop and increase the dose based on personal preference. Do I mix Pumped with my ADA and Amped pre-workout? Yes, they can all be combined into an all-in-one pre-workout drink. I don't lift weights, but I exercise regularly. Can I use Pumped? Yes, Pumped is formulated for a wide range of athletes seeking enhanced recovery and improved performance, not just weight lifters. description.html: What are athletic performance supplements? Dietary supplements to enhance exercise and athletic performance come in a variety of forms, including tablets, capsules, liquids, powders, and bars. Many contain numerous ingredients in varied combinations and amounts, among the more common ingredients are amino acids, protein, creatine, and caffeine. What are the benefits of athletic performance supplements? They can help enhance your ability to get the most out of your training and improve mental and physical performance potential. Who can use athletic performance supplements? Healthy people looking to squeeze more out of their training. FAQs Q How quickly can I expect to see performance improvements? A Results are different for everyone and based on many factors factors including your goals, training intensity and food choices. These supplements cannot do the work for you. They are supplements and not intended to take the place of hard work. Q How do they work? A They are designed to work in a variety of ways including but not limited to, helping your body absorb more nutrients, increasing your body’s efficiency at removing waste products from your muscles, and much more. Q Where can I get more info on your supplements? A You can call our knowledgable customer care team and they can help answer any questions you may have.

What are "Pre-Workout" supplements? Pre-workouts explained: Everything you need to know before you hit the gym With bodybuilders, runners, and everyone in between looking for every training advantage they can get, the demand for cutting edge products continues to grow. In years past the only option athletes could utilize to get more out of their workouts was coffee, but today that has all changed because pre-workouts have become the go-to drink of choice for anyone looking to squeeze more out of their workouts. What are "Pre-Workout" supplements? Pre-Workout supplements such as creatine, amino-acids, caffeine, nitric oxide agents, and more. They generally come in powder form to be mixed as a delicious drink but many are also sold in pill form. Thanks to improvements in science todays pre-workouts can be fine tuned to achieve a wide variety of incredible physical and mental boosting results. The benefits of "Pre-workout supplements" In addition to improving VO2 max, pre-workouts have been shown to improve strength, focus, endurance, and mood. Who should use them? Healthy adults over 18 should be able to tolerate most pre-workouts well and see improvements in their athletic performance. However, pre-workouts aren’t for everyone. Those who are sensitive to caffeine or other stimulants may not tolerate pre-workouts well, especially if taken too late in the day. FAQs Q Can you stack pre-workouts? A Yes, but not with other stimulant based products. Our pre-workouts can be combined with ADABOLIC, Andro’s, ATP-Fusion. Q When should I take my pre-workout? A Take them 20 to 30 minutes before you exercise to see maximum benefits. Q Will pre-workouts affect my sleep? A While everyone reacts differently, it’s advised to avoid taking a pre-workout 6-8 hours before you go to sleep. Q Will they make me jittery? A Any pre-workout has the potential to make you jittery, but it really depends on how well you tolerate stimulants. We recommend you start with a 1/4 scoop to assess your tolerance.

description.html: What are Fat burner supplements? Fat burners a category of supplements that are designed to increase your body’s fat burning potential and energy expenditure, impede fat absorption, and speed fat loss. What are the benefits of fat burners? Fat burners help to enhance fat loss, boost energy, curb appetite and help your body burn more calories throughout the day. Who should use them? Anyone who is healthy and wants to get rid of stubborn belly fat. If you have been stuck at a plateau and are looking for something to melt the last bit of fat off your frame then this could be a simple addition that makes a huge difference for you. FAQs Q Can I eat whatever I want and see results using fat burners? A No. They aren’t magic pills. However, when combined with healthy food choices and regular exercise they can enhance your body’s fat loss and fat burning potential and you can see incredible results. Q How much extra weight could I lose using a fat burner? A Everyone is different and the results may vary for you as an individual, but the most effective way to utilize a fat burning supplement is to combine it with a rigorous exercise program and healthy eating. Q When is the best time of day to take a fat burner? A Because fat burners are stimulants they are best taken in the morning, this way your sleep won’t be affected from taking stimulants too close to bed time.

For Andro Guide: Click Here Description Suggested Use Ingredients The Ripped Stack is Steel’s advanced hardening, recomp, and physique-focused Andro stack, built for experienced users who want muscle hardness, definition, strength support, fullness, and a sharper, more dialed-in look during a structured cutting or recomposition phase. This stack combines three different physique-focused lanes: 3-EPI-ANDRO for dry hardening, density, and vascularity; 7,3-ANDRO for recomp, cutting support, definition, and a tighter look; and 17a-ANDRO for advanced stack support, fullness, appetite support, strength support, and cycle depth. This is not a basic fat burner stack. The Ripped Stack is built for users who are already training hard, eating with discipline, and looking to sharpen the physique while supporting strength, fullness, and performance during a serious cut or recomp phase. Built To Support Dry hardening-focused cycles Recomposition support Definition and density Muscle hardness Vascularity and a sharper look Strength support while leaning out Fullness support during a cut Advanced physique-focused cycle structure Experienced users chasing a leaner, harder, more dialed-in physique Stack Snapshot Included Products:3-EPI-ANDRO7,3-ANDRO17a-ANDROStack Type:Advanced hardening, recomp, definition, and fullness-support stackPrimary Lane:Cutting, recomposition, muscle hardness, definition, vascularity, strength support, and cycle depthBest For:Experienced users in a cutting or recomp phase who want a harder, tighter, more defined physique without relying on a stimulant fat burner as the centerpiece Why This Stack Works The Ripped Stack works because each product controls a different part of the physique-focused phase. 3-EPI-ANDRO brings the dry hardening lane, helping support muscle density, vascularity, strength, and the sharper cosmetic edge users want when leaning out. 7,3-ANDRO supports the recomp and definition lane, helping users pursue a tighter, leaner, more dialed-in look during a structured cutting or recomposition phase. 17a-ANDRO adds advanced stack support, helping round out the cycle with fullness, appetite support, strength support, and more overall cycle depth. Together, these three Andros create a more complete physique-focused system than any single product can provide alone: dry hardness from 3-EPI-ANDRO, recomp and definition support from 7,3-ANDRO, and advanced fullness and strength support from 17a-ANDRO. Who This Stack Is For The Ripped Stack is designed for experienced users who understand structured Andro cycles and want a more advanced hardening and recomp-focused option than a single-product run. This stack is best for users focused on: Cutting Recomposition Hardness Definition Vascularity Strength support Fullness while leaning out Physique-focused training phases A tighter, drier, more conditioned look If you are new to Andros, start with a simpler cycle first. More is not always better. The right stack is the one that matches your goal, experience level, training status, nutrition, recovery, and tolerance. Best Used For Cutting Phases: Use the Ripped Stack during a disciplined calorie deficit when the goal is definition, hardness, vascularity, and a leaner look while keeping strength and fullness in focus. Recomp Phases: This stack fits well when the goal is to improve body composition, support lean performance, and build a harder, more athletic look without chasing scale weight alone. Hardening Phases: The combination of 3-EPI-ANDRO and 7,3-ANDRO makes this stack especially relevant for users who want a dry, dense, sharper physique. Advanced Physique Cycles: 17a-ANDRO adds cycle depth for users who want more strength, fullness, and support during a more aggressive physique-focused phase. Nutrition Guidance Do not run a ripped stack while eating like you have no plan. For best results, support this stack with: High protein intake Controlled calorie deficit or maintenance intake Strategic carbohydrates around training Consistent meal structure Hydration and electrolytes Resistance training Sleep and recovery discipline This stack is built for visual change, but visual change still requires execution. If calories are sloppy, protein is low, hydration is poor, and sleep is wrecked, the stack will not save the plan. The goal is not just to lose weight. The goal is to look harder, fuller, tighter, and more conditioned. Training Guidance The Ripped Stack should be paired with structured training, not random punishment. Best training styles include: Hypertrophy training Strength-focused lifting High-volume bodybuilding Recomp-focused training blocks Conditioning work paired with resistance training Lift weights. Fat loss and recomp look better when muscle stays. Cardio can help increase calorie expenditure, but resistance training should remain the foundation if the goal is a lean, hard, muscular look. Train hard, but train intelligently. A harder physique is built through progressive training, smart nutrition, hydration, and recovery — not just adding more products. Lifestyle Guidance For best results during this stack: Avoid alcohol during use Do not exceed recommended use Stay hydrated Maintain electrolyte intake Prioritize sleep Keep protein intake high Avoid crash dieting Avoid unnecessary stimulant abuse Avoid recreational drugs Follow the cycle with proper post-cycle support This stack is for users who are ready to execute. Diet, training, hydration, recovery, and consistency matter just as much as the products. Post-Cycle Support Because the Ripped Stack includes structured Andro use, post-cycle support should be part of the plan from the beginning. Steel recommends following Andro cycles with ALPHA, Steel’s natural testosterone support and post-cycle support formula. ALPHA is designed to support natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, performance, and the transition after advanced Andro use. Do not treat post-cycle support as an afterthought. If you are planning the stack, plan the recovery phase too. Cycle Length Guidance Steel Andro stacks are designed for structured cycle-based use, not indefinite daily use. Most users structure Andro cycles around defined 4-week or 8-week phases, followed by post-cycle support and time off. A 4-week cycle is the more conservative approach and may be better suited for users who are newer to structured cycle planning or using a stack for the first time. An 8-week cycle should be reserved for experienced users who understand their tolerance, training, nutrition, hydration, recovery, and post-cycle support needs. Larger multi-product stacks should be approached conservatively before extending cycle length. Do not run Andro stacks continuously. Do not exceed label directions. Do not combine with alcohol, recreational drugs, or unnecessary stressors that can work against recovery, hydration, liver health, hormone balance, sleep, and training performance. After completing a cycle, use ALPHA as post-cycle support and allow time off before beginning another Andro cycle. More is not always better. Choose cycle length based on experience level, goal, tolerance, training phase, and ability to recover properly. Individual Product Details For a deeper breakdown of each product, review the individual 3-EPI-ANDRO, 7,3-ANDRO, and 17a-ANDRO product pages. Those pages explain each product in greater detail. This page explains why these three products are combined and how the full stack is designed to support a serious hardening, recomp, and physique-focused phase. Important Use Notice This stack is intended for experienced adult users only. Not for use by individuals under 18. Do not use if pregnant, nursing, or trying to become pregnant. This stack contains hormone-pathway products. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use if you have or have had liver, kidney, cardiovascular, blood pressure, endocrine, cholesterol, prostate, hormone-sensitive, or other medical concerns, or if you take prescription medications. Discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional if you experience adverse reactions. Final Note The Ripped Stack is built for one purpose: hardness, definition, vascularity, strength support, fullness, and a leaner, sharper physique. 3-EPI-ANDRO brings the dry hardening lane. 7,3-ANDRO supports recomp and definition. 17a-ANDRO adds advanced fullness, strength, and stack depth. Together, they create one of Steel’s most complete hardening and physique-focused Andro stacks. Run it with structure. Eat with discipline. Train with intent. Hydrate like it matters. Recover properly. Follow with ALPHA. Product Video

description.html: For Andro Guide: Click Here Description Suggested Use Product Ingredients "No man has the right to be an amateur in the matter of physical training. It is a shame for a man to grow old without seeing the beauty and strength of which his body is capable.” – Socrates If ever you are seeking to prove something to someone, make sure that person is yourself. Few and far between are those who know what it means to push their bodies and physical limits to their absolute potential. Lean muscle gains, peak conditioning, muscular fullness and dryness, maintaining strength and driving mental clarity until the very end, The Ultimate Ripped Stack was designed with this in mind, to achieve YOUR best, and to show yourself exactly what you are capable of. Consisting of 1-Andro, 3-EPI-Andro, and 7,3-Andro, these are the elite Andros when it comes to sculpting your end-goal physique. To further assist in this goal, we have included Alpha-AF for proper estrogen control, while increasing natural testosterone to promote enhanced muscle dryness, strength maintenance, and proper hormonal balance. 3-EPI is the best choice when looking to trigger max body-fat mobilization, manage cortisol to ensure increased recovery and avoid muscle degradation, and give the user a highly-conditioned, dialed in physique. The E controlling functionality and its ability to give your muscles that hard dry appearance help establish 3-EPIs place in the Ultimate Ripped Stack. 7,3-ANDRO is known as our Andro Optimizer, so it has been included in the Ultimate Ripped Stack to maximize the anabolic and androgenic activities of 1-Andro and 3-EPI-Andro. 7,3 combats naturally occurring E, in addition to controlling rates of aromatization. 7,3-Andro also offers its own fat-mobilizing characteristic without interrupting the mechanisms of action that 1-Andro and 3-EPI utilize, ensuring that body-fat is being targeted from all angles. Factor in whole-body muscular recovery, and encouraging increased protein synthesis while improving nitrogen retention, 7,3 is here to supercharge your results and prime your body for peak composition. 1-ANDRO is essential for maintaining muscle mass while in a caloric deficit. 1-Andro also works to increase skeletal muscle activation, improve rates of recovery, and ramp up protein synthesis. The dry nature of 1-Andro makes it an ideal inclusion for the individual looking to bring out their best physique possible.ALPHA-AF is an active E-controlling, natural T increasing formulation that is designed to optimize hormonal levels conducive to getting as lean as possible while retaining muscle mass. A partial dosage of Alpha-AF alongside your Andros will help to drive results to the next level, and you will be able to use your remaining Alpha-AF for PCT purposes. *Due to the sensitive and highly limited ingredients used in the STEEL products, for customer safety, we do not accept returns as returned items cannot be restocked. Please carefully consider this before your purchase. Stack Components: 3-EPI-ANDRO 7, 3-ANDRO 1-ANDRO ALPHA-AF Suggested use - How do I take the Ultimate Ripped Stack? AM Protocol: In the morning upon waking up, take 1 tablet of 1-Andro, 3-Epi-Andro, and 7,3-Andro in addition to 1 capsule of Alpha-AF on an empty stomach (4 pills total). Wait 30-60 minutes before consuming food. PM Protocol: 10-12 hours following your AM dose, take 1 tablet of 1-Andro, 3-Epi-Andro, and 7,3-Andro on an empty stomach (3 pills total). Wait 30-60 minutes before consuming food. Once you have fully finished your Andro cycle, take 3 capsules of Alpha-AF in the morning with a meal until the PCT has been completed. Do I need on-cycle therapy or liver support? With any of our Andros, on-cycle support is not required. Our Andros are manufactured using liposomal technology, ensuring zero liver toxicity. We also do not fill our Andros with filler or junk ingredients, so you are only getting the Andros you want. Does it matter if I take these with food? We HIGHLY recommend taking the Andros on an empty stomach for optimal Andro absorption and utilization. You run Andros for limited amounts of time, so it is crucial to follow habits that maximize your uptake. Side effects? Because everyone's body is different, it is impossible to say which individual is going to experience different effects. Due to our proper dosing and liposomal technology with the Andros, side effects are mitigated as much as possible. Following up your Andro cycle with Alpha-AF for PCT will further mitigate these risks and help you lock in your progress while restoring hormonal balance to your body. 3-EPI Ingredients 7 Hydroxy-Dehydroxepiandrosterone 25mg, Epiandrosterone 100mg Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidylcholine, Hydroxypropyl-Beta-Cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica. 1-ANDRO Ingredients 1-DHEA Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidylcholine, Hydroxypropyl-Beta-Cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica, FD&C Red #40. 7,3-ANDRO Ingredients 3-Hydroxy-Androstane-17-One 100mg, 7a-Hydroxy-Dehydroepiandrosterone 25mg, 6-Keto Diosgenin 50mg. Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidylcholine, Hydroxypropyl-Beta-Cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica. Alpha-AF Ingredients Vitamin B6 (as Pyridoxine HCl) 10mg, Vitamin D (as Cholecalciferol) 50mcg, Magnesium (as Magnesium Aspartate Complex) 90mg, Zinc (as Zinc Glycinate) 30mg, Byronia Lacinosa 1g, Safed Musli (Chlorophylum Borivilanum) (50% Saponins) 500mg, Magnesium Aspartate Complex 450mg, Acaetin 50mg, Dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA) 30mg, Boron (as Boron Citrate and Boron Glycinate) 6mg, Black Pepper Fruit Extract 95% (Piper Nigrum) 5mg. Other Ingredients: Gelatin (Capsules), Titanium Dioxide, FD&C Blue #1, Silicon Dioxide, Magnesium Stearate. Product Videos

description.html: What are Fat burner supplements? Fat burners a category of supplements that are designed to increase your body’s fat burning potential and energy expenditure, impede fat absorption, and speed fat loss. What are the benefits of fat burners? Fat burners help to enhance fat loss, boost energy, curb appetite and help your body burn more calories throughout the day. Who should use them? Anyone who is healthy and wants to get rid of stubborn belly fat. If you have been stuck at a plateau and are looking for something to melt the last bit of fat off your frame then this could be a simple addition that makes a huge difference for you. FAQs Q Can I eat whatever I want and see results using fat burners? A No. They aren’t magic pills. However, when combined with healthy food choices and regular exercise they can enhance your body’s fat loss and fat burning potential and you can see incredible results. Q How much extra weight could I lose using a fat burner? A Everyone is different and the results may vary for you as an individual, but the most effective way to utilize a fat burning supplement is to combine it with a rigorous exercise program and healthy eating. Q When is the best time of day to take a fat burner? A Because fat burners are stimulants they are best taken in the morning, this way your sleep won’t be affected from taking stimulants too close to bed time.

What are “T-Booster“ supplements? T is the male hormone that plays an important role in every man’s life and it naturally declines with age. The older you get the more your T-levels drop. T-boosters are supplements that contain natural ingredients formulated to increase your body’s ability to produce T and utilize free T circulating in the blood. What are the benefits of “T-Booster supplements”? Men using these supplements report feeling more confident, increased muscle growth, drive, stamina, more power and strength, a better mood, enhanced libido, more endurance and much more. Who should use them? Men 25 and over who want to improve their libido, build muscle, and improve their overall drive. FAQs Q What is an Andro? A Our Andros are DHEA precursors that provide various muscle building and fat burning benefits, such as increasing T levels or mobilizing stored body fat, depending on the particular compound. Q What can I expect from using a T-booster? A Everyone reacts differently but men of all ages frequently report improved mood, more confidence, lean muscle gains, and rapid fat loss. Q What T-Booster should I take? A That depends on your goals. Reach out to our friendly and experienced customer care team with your questions and they can explain what each of our products are designed to do in more detail.

Description Suggested Use Product Ingredients Give yourself a performance edge, while supporting muscle recovery and cognitive performance as you progress towards your weight loss goals. The Tone-Up/Shred-Up Stack, fantastic for both men and women, supplies you with Shredded-AF, our most potent thermogenic fat burner, and Veg-PRO, a 100% vegan friendly protein ideal for aiding in muscular recovery and biomechanical efficiency. Shredded-AF offers you peak levels of clean energy while optimizing your cognitive function throughout the day, as it works to rip stored fat from your body and convert it into brown adipose tissue for fuel. Veg-PRO contains 20g of protein to aid in muscular recovery after a strenuous workout, or as a great addition to a healthy snack to keep you on track and hitting your daily protein requirements. Regardless if you are just getting started, or are looking for that last push to dial in your physique, the Tone-Up/Shred-Up Stack is a great addition to your health and wellness lineup. Backed by Science to Help Optimize: • Surreal Energy & Focus* • Supports Muscle Recovery* • Promotes Muscle & Growth Repair* Also included in this stack: Try the Line Kit (towel, shaker & 11 samples), Stainless Steel Bottle . Try the Line Kit is automatically added to your cart at checkout. *Due to the sensitive and highly limited ingredients used in the STEEL products, for customer safety, we do not accept returns as returned items cannot be restocked. Please carefully consider this before your purchase. Suggested Use - Directions SHREDDED-AF - Suggested maximum dose is 2 capsules per day. Based on each individual, this can be taken as 2 capsules once per day or 1 capsule twice per day (with a minimum of 6 hours between doses). If you've never taken Shredded-AF before, we recommend starting with 1 capsule per day to assess tolerance before progressing to 2 capsules per day. VEG PRO - Mix 1 scoop of VEG PRO in 6–8 oz of water or your liquid of choice. Shake vigorously. Each serving provides 20g of protein. For optimal muscle recovery, we suggest taking Veg-PRO 30–120 minutes after your workout. How old must I be to take this? You must be at least 18 years old. Can I take Andros with this stack? Yes, you're able to take this stack with Andros. Can women take this stack? Yes, this stack can be used by both women and men. Can I take a pre-workout with this stack? Yes, but do not take a pre-workout or any stimulants within 6–8 hours of taking Shredded-AF. If you would like to use Shredded-AF as a pre-workout, we suggest stacking it with Pumped-AF and N.O.7. How many times can I use this stack? Due to the human body's ability to rapidly adapt to stimulant intake, we encourage customers to use this stack for a maximum of 12 weeks, followed by a 4-week break. Product Videos

description.html: What are Fat burner supplements? Fat burners a category of supplements that are designed to increase your body’s fat burning potential and energy expenditure, impede fat absorption, and speed fat loss. What are the benefits of fat burners? Fat burners help to enhance fat loss, boost energy, curb appetite and help your body burn more calories throughout the day. Who should use them? Anyone who is healthy and wants to get rid of stubborn belly fat. If you have been stuck at a plateau and are looking for something to melt the last bit of fat off your frame then this could be a simple addition that makes a huge difference for you. FAQs Q Can I eat whatever I want and see results using fat burners? A No. They aren’t magic pills. However, when combined with healthy food choices and regular exercise they can enhance your body’s fat loss and fat burning potential and you can see incredible results. Q How much extra weight could I lose using a fat burner? A Everyone is different and the results may vary for you as an individual, but the most effective way to utilize a fat burning supplement is to combine it with a rigorous exercise program and healthy eating. Q When is the best time of day to take a fat burner? A Because fat burners are stimulants they are best taken in the morning, this way your sleep won’t be affected from taking stimulants too close to bed time.

description.html: For samples of VEG-PUDDING Click here Description Product FAQ Product INGREDIENTS Veg-Pudding is a vegan protein pudding, consisting of organic pea and brown rice protein sources to provide you with a clean, complete amino acid profile. As you may know from our Veg-PRO, we want to make sure our protein flavors knock it out of the park, so we poured tons of hours into R&D time, trying various flavor combinations and are confident that you guys are going to love these as much as we do. STEEL's Veg-Pudding has been taste-tested extensively by adults and kids. So, mom and dad, if you have a picky-eater and struggle to help get them enough protein throughout the day, we have you covered. How do I take Veg-Pudding? Adults (Ages 12+): Mix 1 scoop of pudding in 4–5oz of cold water (or liquid of choice) and stir vigorously. Liquid can be increased or decreased to achieve the desired consistency. Children (Ages 5–11): Mix ½ scoop of pudding in 2oz of cold water (or liquid of choice) and stir vigorously. Liquid can be increased or decreased to achieve the desired consistency. Is this safe for kids? Absolutely. Veg-Pudding is formulated free of the most common food allergens and is gentle on digestive systems. If your child has specific medical or nutritional concerns, consult your pediatrician before introducing new foods. Can I still use protein powders such as Whey Pro, Iso, or Veg-PRO with Veg-Pudding? Yes. There are no negative interactions with any of our protein powders or other STEEL products. You can incorporate Veg-Pudding as another convenient way to help meet your daily protein goals alongside any other STEEL supplements you are using. description.html: What are muscle recovery supplements? They are supplements designed to help your muscles recover and refuel from damage done during workouts. There are many types of recovery supplements from those that help you get better sleep to those that feed your muscles the nutrients necessary for continued growth. What are the benefits of muscle recovery supplements? In order for your muscles to grow you need to damage them. The quicker your body can repair the damage the more your muscles will grow. Athletes using recovery supplements experience reduced muscle soreness, and improved recovery times.. Who should use them? Everybody can benefit from muscle recovery supplements like BCAA’s, protein, L-carnitine, creatine and more. FAQs Q Will a fat loss supplement work if I don’t change what I eat? A No. They are designed to be just that, a supplement. They may enhance your body’s ability to burn fat but nothing can take the place of healthy eating and exercise. Q What is the best time to take a fat loss supplement? A That depends. If it contains stimulants the best time is take it in the morning so it won’t affect your sleep. Q Can fat loss supplements interact with medications? A Maybe. Every fat loss supplement can contain a variety of ingredients so an interaction is possible. That’s why it’s important to consult your doctor if you’re considering taking a fat loss supplement.

What are Muscle Building supplements? Muscle building supplements are supplements designed to help improve physical performance during resistance training and stimulate muscle growth. Protein and creatine are great examples of this category of supplements. What are the benefits of taking muscle building supplements? They can help your body repair muscle damage done during resistance training faster and help you recover quicker. Who can take muscle building supplements? Anyone looking to improve their athletic performance and enhance their muscle growth. FAQs Q Can protein shakes be used as a meal replacement? A No. Supplements can be used to fill in the gaps of your daily nutrition, like a snack, but nothing can take the place of eating high quality healthy food every day. Q What is the recommended time to drink a protein shake? A They are great any time of day but most people use them post-workout was a quick way to refuel their muscles to aid recovery.

title: 7 oz. Steel Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky

description.html: Introducing a culinary first for Steel: Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky. Sourced from the highest quality meats, our Brisket Beef Jerky is tender, packed with flavor, and perfectly chewable. Each bag is crafted with natural ingredients that do not compromise on flavor, providing you with a clean way to enjoy your favorite treat. Korean BBQ: An in-house favorite, Korean BBQ is a great fit for tender brisket. Gluten-free tamari, a bit of sweetness, garlic & onion, finished with a blend of mouth-watering spices makes for a truly unique flavor. If you are looking for something new, we highly recommend this flavor.Cracked Pepper: A classic flavor leaning heavily into the rustic, traditional flavor of Cracked Pepper straight from the mill. Beef jerky traditionalists will appreciate the simple, powerful taste. It’s the classic, done right.Teriyaki: A classic flavor, providing the ideal balance between soy sauce, light pineapple, and Worcestershire. Pops of savory garlic, tamarind, and clove help to elevate the flavor to a new level with a small but noticeable twist on traditional Teriyaki. Spicy Sweet: Spicy Sweet brings a novel approach to how brisket beef jerky is typically seasoned, hitting you with equal notes of heat and sweetness. Fans of Kansas City-style barbecue sauce will know what to expect, and the seasoning compliments the tenderness of our brisket just right. Smoky BBQ: A mesquite style barbecue approach with hits of rustic tomato, gluten-free tamari, onion, garlic, and a delicious blend of peppers. Smoky BBQ has a heavy, straightforward taste you can savor. Carne Asada: If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Carne Asada plays it tried and true by incorporating orange juice, lime juice, garlic, jalapeños, and other spices in order to bring you a full-flavored experience while keeping the meat perfectly tender.Tropical Fusion: It’s like a vacation in a bag that also has Beef Jerky in it (win-win). Infused with tropical flavors like mango and pineapple, this Beef Jerky has a forward sweetness that is rounded out with classic grilling flavors like garlic, onion and Worcestershire.Salt N Pepper Honey: A classic salt and pepper profile with a sweet twist. Salt N Pepper Honey is generously seasoned and infused with honey, accompanied by other classic Beef Jerky flavors like onion, garlic, ginger, and clove. If you are looking for a modern take on an all-time favorite, Salt N Pepper Honey has you covered. Salt N Pepper Honey, Tropical Fusion, Teriyaki, Korean BBQ & Spicy Sweet are not gluten-free. Smoky BBQ, Cracked Pepper, Buffalo Chicken, Carne Asada & Honey BBQ are gluten-free. Steel Supplements products are manufactured in a facility that handles all common food allergens. Machine sanitation protocols are performed as required, however, cross-contamination is still possible.

description.html: What are Muscle Building supplements? Muscle building supplements are supplements designed to help improve physical performance during resistance training and stimulate muscle growth. Protein and creatine are great examples of this category of supplements. What are the benefits of taking muscle building supplements? They can help your body repair muscle damage done during resistance training faster and help you recover quicker. Who can take muscle building supplements? Anyone looking to improve their athletic performance and enhance their muscle growth. FAQs Q Can protein shakes be used as a meal replacement? A No. Supplements can be used to fill in the gaps of your daily nutrition, like a snack, but nothing can take the place of eating high quality healthy food every day. Q What is the recommended time to drink a protein shake? A They are great any time of day but most people use them post-workout was a quick way to refuel their muscles to aid recovery.

description.html: What are Muscle Building supplements? Muscle building supplements are supplements designed to help improve physical performance during resistance training and stimulate muscle growth. Protein and creatine are great examples of this category of supplements. What are the benefits of taking muscle building supplements? They can help your body repair muscle damage done during resistance training faster and help you recover quicker. Who can take muscle building supplements? Anyone looking to improve their athletic performance and enhance their muscle growth. FAQs Q Can protein shakes be used as a meal replacement? A No. Supplements can be used to fill in the gaps of your daily nutrition, like a snack, but nothing can take the place of eating high quality healthy food every day. Q What is the recommended time to drink a protein shake? A They are great any time of day but most people use them post-workout was a quick way to refuel their muscles to aid recovery.

description.html: For samples of VEG-PRO Click here Description Product FAQ Product Components VEG-PRO is a Non-GMO Verified Pure Vegan Protein powder delivering 20g of dairy free protein complete profile of all the essential amino acids. VEG-PRO is gently produced at low temperatures, without any added fillers or carriers, ensuring the preservation of its complete amino acid integrity. Backed by Science: • DAIRY FREE, SOY FREE, GLUTEN FREE, NON-GMO* • EASILY DIGESTED* • PROMOTES MUSCLES GROWTH & REPAIR* • HIGHEST QUALITY ALTERNATIVE TO SOY, WHEY & MILK PROTEIN* In addition to providing the full amino-acid profile needed to build thick and dense muscles, well-crafted plant-based proteins help with weight management because they tend to be lower in calories and fat, but higher in fiber and other essential nutrients needed to help maintain a healthy digestive balance. Plant-based proteins have also been shown to improve athletes’ performance, energy levels, and recovery. In fact, in an 8-week study conducted in 2018, researchers found that body composition, muscle thickness, force production, and overall performance were the same between pea protein and whey protein groups (1). To put it another way, your 1-rep max isn’t going to suffer using Veg-Pro and your overall health profile may improve. (2) Cookies & Creme Flavor contains gluten. All other flavors are gluten-free. Steel Supplements products are manufactured in a facility that handles all common food allergens. Machine sanitation protocols are performed as required, however, cross-contamination is still possible. Suggested use - How do I take Veg Pro? Mix 1 scoop of VEG-PRO in 6-8oz of water. Shake vigorously. Each serving provides 20 grams of protein. What is the difference between Whey Pro, Veg Pro, and Whey ISO? Whey-PRO is a blend of WPC and WPI for recovery and immune support. Whey-ISO is a rapidly absorbing pure WPI formula that is nearly lactose-free, making it a great option for those who have difficulty digesting lactose. Veg-PRO is a 100% vegan protein powder consisting of pea protein isolate and brown rice protein. Glutamic Acid, Aspartic Acid, Leucine, Arginine, Valine, Alanine, Phenylalanine, Tyrosine, Serine, Proline, Glycine, Isoleucine, Threonine, Methionline, Lysine, Cysteine, Histidine. Other Ingredients: Brown Rice Protein, Pea Protein Isolate, D-Ribose, Maltodextrin, Beet Root Extract, Natural Flavors, Xanthan Gum, Stevia Extract (95% Steviol Glycosides), Sucralose, Silicon Dioxide. + SCIENTIFIC DATA [1] https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6358922/ [2] https://academic.oup.com/jn/article/147/3/281/4584732 Product Video function scrollToSciData(e) { e.preventDefault(); const el = document.getElementById("sci-data"); el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block: "center"}); el.getAttribute('open') || el.setAttribute('open', true); }

title: 1 oz. Steel Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky

description.html: Introducing a culinary first for Steel: Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky. Sourced from the highest quality meats, our Brisket Beef Jerky is tender, packed with flavor, and perfectly chewable. Each bag is crafted with natural ingredients that do not compromise on flavor, providing you with a clean way to enjoy your favorite treat. Korean BBQ: An in-house favorite, Korean BBQ is a great fit for tender brisket. Gluten-free tamari, a bit of sweetness, garlic & onion, finished with a blend of mouth-watering spices makes for a truly unique flavor. If you are looking for something new, we highly recommend this flavor.Cracked Pepper: A classic flavor leaning heavily into the rustic, traditional flavor of Cracked Pepper straight from the mill. Beef jerky traditionalists will appreciate the simple, powerful taste. It’s the classic, done right.Teriyaki: A classic flavor, providing the ideal balance between soy sauce, light pineapple, and Worcestershire. Pops of savory garlic, tamarind, and clove help to elevate the flavor to a new level with a small but noticeable twist on traditional Teriyaki. Spicy Sweet: Spicy Sweet brings a novel approach to how brisket beef jerky is typically seasoned, hitting you with equal notes of heat and sweetness. Fans of Kansas City-style barbecue sauce will know what to expect, and the seasoning compliments the tenderness of our brisket just right. Smoky BBQ: A mesquite style barbecue approach with hits of rustic tomato, gluten-free tamari, onion, garlic, and a delicious blend of peppers. Smoky BBQ has a heavy, straightforward taste you can savor. Carne Asada: If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Carne Asada plays it tried and true by incorporating orange juice, lime juice, garlic, jalapeños, and other spices in order to bring you a full-flavored experience while keeping the meat perfectly tender.Tropical Fusion: It’s like a vacation in a bag that also has Beef Jerky in it (win-win). Infused with tropical flavors like mango and pineapple, this Beef Jerky has a forward sweetness that is rounded out with classic grilling flavors like garlic, onion and Worcestershire.Salt N Pepper Honey: A classic salt and pepper profile with a sweet twist. Salt N Pepper Honey is generously seasoned and infused with honey, accompanied by other classic Beef Jerky flavors like onion, garlic, ginger, and clove. If you are looking for a modern take on an all-time favorite, Salt N Pepper Honey has you covered. Salt N Pepper Honey, Tropical Fusion, Teriyaki, Korean BBQ & Spicy Sweet are not gluten-free. Smoky BBQ, Cracked Pepper, Buffalo Chicken, Carne Asada & Honey BBQ are gluten-free. Steel Supplements products are manufactured in a facility that handles all common food allergens. Machine sanitation protocols are performed as required, however, cross-contamination is still possible.

description.html: What are Muscle Building supplements? Muscle building supplements are supplements designed to help improve physical performance during resistance training and stimulate muscle growth. Protein and creatine are great examples of this category of supplements. What are the benefits of taking muscle building supplements? They can help your body repair muscle damage done during resistance training faster and help you recover quicker. Who can take muscle building supplements? Anyone looking to improve their athletic performance and enhance their muscle growth. FAQs Q Can protein shakes be used as a meal replacement? A No. Supplements can be used to fill in the gaps of your daily nutrition, like a snack, but nothing can take the place of eating high quality healthy food every day. Q What is the recommended time to drink a protein shake? A They are great any time of day but most people use them post-workout was a quick way to refuel their muscles to aid recovery.

It’s the classic, done right.Teriyaki: A classic flavor, providing the ideal balance between soy sauce, light pineapple, and Worcestershire. Pops of savory garlic, tamarind, and clove help to elevate the flavor to a new level with a small but noticeable twist on traditional Teriyaki. Spicy Sweet: Spicy Sweet brings a novel approach to how brisket beef jerky is typically seasoned, hitting you with equal notes of heat and sweetness. Fans of Kansas City-style barbecue sauce will know what to expect, and the seasoning compliments the tenderness of our brisket just right. Smoky BBQ: A mesquite style barbecue approach with hits of rustic tomato, gluten-free tamari, onion, garlic, and a delicious blend of peppers. Smoky BBQ has a heavy, straightforward taste you can savor. Carne Asada: If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Carne Asada plays it tried and true by incorporating orange juice, lime juice, garlic, jalapeños, and other spices in order to bring you a full-flavored experience while keeping the meat perfectly tender.Tropical Fusion: It’s like a vacation in a bag that also has Beef Jerky in it (win-win). Infused with tropical flavors like mango and pineapple, this Beef Jerky has a forward sweetness that is rounded out with classic grilling flavors like garlic, onion and Worcestershire.Salt N Pepper Honey: A classic salt and pepper profile with a sweet twist. Salt N Pepper Honey is generously seasoned and infused with honey, accompanied by other classic Beef Jerky flavors like onion, garlic, ginger, and clove. If you are looking for a modern take on an all-time favorite, Salt N Pepper Honey has you covered.Salt N Pepper Honey, Tropical Fusion, Teriyaki, Korean BBQ & Spicy Sweet are not gluten-free. Smoky BBQ, Cracked Pepper, Buffalo Chicken, Carne Asada & Honey BBQ are gluten-free. Steel Supplements products are manufactured in a facility that handles all common food allergens. Machine sanitation protocols are performed as required, however, cross-contamination is still possible.

This stack combines SHREDDED, ALPHA, and RESTED into one performance-support routine. SHREDDED: supports thermogenic energy, focus, appetite-control support, metabolism support, and disciplined body-composition execution. ALPHA: supports natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, performance, and male hormone-support nutrition. RESTED: supports relaxation, sleep quality, nighttime recovery, and next-day readiness. This is not just a fat-loss stack. It is not just a testosterone-support stack. It is not just a sleep stack. The ARETE Stack is built around the bigger picture: energy during the day, hormone-support nutrition, disciplined body-composition execution, and recovery at night. ARETE means excellence. This stack is built for users who want to chase that standard with structure. Built To Support Body-composition focused phases Thermogenic energy Focus and mental drive Appetite-control support Metabolism support Calorie-controlled dieting Natural testosterone support Healthy estrogen balance Male performance support Drive and motivation Recovery-focused wellness Relaxation and sleep quality Nighttime recovery Next-day readiness Training consistency Lean muscle support routines Fat-loss support routines Users who want a more complete day-and-night performance stack Stack Snapshot Included Products: SHREDDED ALPHA RESTED Stack Type: Body-composition, thermogenic, hormone-support, sleep, recovery, and performance stack Primary Lane: Energy, focus, appetite-control support, fat-loss support, natural testosterone support, healthy estrogen balance, sleep quality, recovery, and daily execution Best For: Lifters, active users, body-composition focused users, men in structured fat-loss phases, high-output users, hard-training users, and anyone who wants energy, hormone-support nutrition, and recovery support in one system Why This Stack Works The ARETE Stack works because it supports the full daily cycle: daytime execution, hormone-support nutrition, and nighttime recovery. SHREDDED: supports the body-composition execution lane. It is built to support thermogenic energy, focus, appetite-control support, metabolism support, and a more disciplined cutting phase. ALPHA: supports the hormone-support lane. It is built to support natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, performance, and the male-performance foundation. RESTED: supports the recovery lane. It is built to support relaxation, sleep quality, nighttime recovery, and next-day readiness. Together, these three products create a more complete body-composition system: SHREDDED supports energy, focus, thermogenesis, appetite-control support, and body-composition execution. ALPHA supports natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, and hormone-support nutrition. RESTED supports relaxation, sleep quality, recovery, and next-day readiness. SHREDDED helps you execute during the day. ALPHA helps support the hormone foundation. RESTED helps support recovery at night. That is why this stack makes sense. Who This Stack Is For The ARETE Stack is designed for users who want more than a basic fat-loss support product. This stack is a strong fit for: Lifters in a cutting phase Active users chasing a leaner look Men focused on body composition Users who want thermogenic energy Users who want appetite-control support Users who want focus and training drive Users who want natural testosterone support Users who want healthy estrogen-balance support Users who want better recovery routines Users who want sleep-support nutrition at night Users who want a complete day-and-night support system Users who understand that results come from training, nutrition, recovery, and consistency If your goal is to lose fat, support hormone balance, recover better, sleep better, and execute with more discipline, the ARETE Stack is the lane. This stack is not a replacement for training, nutrition, hydration, or sleep hygiene. It is built to support users who are actually ready to do the work. Product Roles Inside The Stack SHREDDED The thermogenic and body-composition execution driver. SHREDDED is built for users who want energy, focus, appetite-control support, thermogenic support, and body-composition execution during a structured fat-loss phase. It helps support the discipline side of the plan. Use: SHREDDED when the goal is to stay energized, focused, and consistent while working through a calorie-controlled routine. ALPHA The natural testosterone and hormone-support layer. ALPHA is built for users who want support for natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, male performance, and overall hormone-support nutrition. It helps support the internal performance foundation. Use: ALPHA when the goal is to support the hormone side of the plan while training, nutrition, recovery, and consistency are being handled. RESTED The sleep and recovery-support layer. RESTED is built for users who want support for relaxation, sleep quality, nighttime recovery, and next-day readiness. It helps support the recovery side of the system. Use: RESTED when the goal is to calm the system down, support better sleep quality, and wake up more ready to execute the next day. Why The ARETE Stack Matters Most users try to improve body composition with only one lever. They take a fat-loss product but ignore sleep. They train hard but recover poorly. They chase testosterone support but do not manage body fat, stress, or sleep. They cut calories but let energy, mood, and consistency fall apart. They want results but fail to build the full system. The ARETE Stack is built differently. It supports the major pieces that matter: Energy Focus Appetite-control support Thermogenic support Body-composition execution Natural testosterone support Healthy estrogen balance Drive and performance Sleep quality Nighttime recovery Next-day readiness Training consistency Nutrition discipline This is the difference between “taking something” and building a routine. SHREDDED helps support the cut. ALPHA helps support the hormone foundation. RESTED helps support recovery. That is the architecture. The Day + Night Performance System The ARETE Stack makes sense because it supports both sides of the day. Daytime Execution SHREDDED is used to support energy, focus, appetite-control support, thermogenic support, and body-composition execution. This is the work side of the stack: training, movement, nutrition discipline, calorie control, focus, and output. Hormone-Support Foundation ALPHA is used to support natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, and male-performance nutrition. This is the foundation side of the stack: keeping the internal support system aligned while the user pushes training, dieting, and performance. Nighttime Recovery RESTED is used to support relaxation, sleep quality, recovery, and next-day readiness. This is the recovery side of the stack: calming down, sleeping deeper, recovering better, and preparing to execute again. Performance does not stop when the workout ends. The user who sleeps better, recovers better, and wakes up ready has a real advantage. ARETE Stack vs. Shredded Stack Steel’s body-composition stacks are built in levels. Shredded Stack: SHREDDED + BCAAS/EAAS Best for users who want fat-loss support with amino acids, hydration, training endurance, and recovery support. Whey ISO Shredded Stack: SHREDDED + WHEY-ISO + BCAAS/EAAS Best for users who want fat-loss support with lean whey isolate protein and amino acid support. Whey PRO Shredded Stack: SHREDDED + WHEY-PRO + BCAAS/EAAS Best for users who want fat-loss support with whey protein and amino acid support. ARETE Stack: SHREDDED + ALPHA + RESTED Best for users who want fat-loss support, hormone-support nutrition, sleep support, recovery support, and a more complete day-and-night execution system. Simple breakdown: Shredded Stack: fat-loss support plus aminos. Whey Shredded Stacks: fat-loss support plus protein and aminos. ARETE Stack: fat-loss support plus hormone support and sleep recovery. The right stack depends on the weak link in the user’s plan. If protein is the gap, choose a protein-based Shredded stack. If the gap is energy, hormone-support nutrition, recovery, and sleep, the ARETE Stack is the smarter play. Best Used For Body-Composition Phases: Use the ARETE Stack during a structured body-composition phase when the goal is energy, focus, appetite-control support, hormone-support nutrition, recovery, and consistency. Fat-Loss Phases: SHREDDED supports the thermogenic energy and appetite-control side of the plan while ALPHA and RESTED support the broader foundation. High-Stress Training Blocks: Hard training, dieting, stress, and poor sleep can work against performance. The ARETE Stack helps support the daily system around output and recovery. Men Focused On Performance + Physique: ALPHA gives this stack a male hormone-support lane, making it especially relevant for users focused on drive, performance, and body composition. Sleep + Recovery Support: RESTED makes this stack more complete than a basic fat-loss stack because recovery matters when the goal is long-term consistency. Users Who Want More Than A Fat Burner: This stack is for users who understand that fat loss and physique progress are not just about stimulation. Sleep, hormones, recovery, nutrition, and consistency matter. How To Use The ARETE Stack Use each product as directed on its label. A practical setup: Daily / As Directed: Use SHREDDED as directed for thermogenic energy, focus, appetite-control support, and body-composition support. Daily / As Directed: Use ALPHA as directed to support natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, male performance, and hormone-support nutrition. Night / As Directed: Use RESTED as directed to support relaxation, sleep quality, nighttime recovery, and next-day readiness. Because SHREDDED contains stimulant-based ingredients, assess tolerance carefully. Use SHREDDED earlier in the day if stimulants affect your sleep. Do not combine SHREDDED with excessive coffee, energy drinks, stimulant-based pre-workouts, or other stimulant-heavy products unless you have carefully accounted for total stimulant intake. More stimulants do not automatically mean better fat loss. More often, they mean worse sleep, worse recovery, higher stress, and a worse plan. Stimulant Use Rules This stack contains SHREDDED, a stimulant-based fat-loss support product. Respect your tolerance. Do not combine the ARETE Stack with PRE, CHARGED, AMPED, excessive coffee, energy drinks, or other stimulant-heavy products unless you have carefully accounted for total caffeine and stimulant intake. If you are sensitive to stimulants, start conservatively. If you train late at night, be smart. Stimulants can interfere with sleep, and poor sleep can work against fat loss, recovery, mood, appetite control, hormone support, and training consistency. The goal is better execution, not stimulant abuse. Sleep + Recovery Guidance RESTED gives the ARETE Stack its nighttime recovery lane. Do not treat sleep like an optional bonus. Sleep impacts recovery, training performance, appetite control, mood, stress response, hormone-support routines, and daily consistency. For best results, use RESTED as part of a real sleep routine: Keep a consistent bedtime when possible Avoid late caffeine Reduce screens before bed Keep the room cool and dark Avoid heavy alcohol use Do not take stimulants too late Give the body time to wind down Treat recovery like part of the plan If SHREDDED helps you execute during the day, RESTED helps support the system that lets you do it again tomorrow. Nutrition Guidance The ARETE Stack works best when the nutrition plan supports the goal. For best results, support this stack with: A controlled calorie deficit if fat loss is the goal High protein intake Consistent hydration Electrolytes Fruits and vegetables Fiber-rich foods Smart carbohydrate timing Healthy dietary fats Resistance training Daily movement Sleep and recovery discipline A plan you can follow consistently Do not use SHREDDED as an excuse to eat like the plan does not matter. SHREDDED can help support energy, focus, appetite-control, and thermogenic output, but body-composition change still requires consistent nutrition. ALPHA supports the hormone-support lane, but lifestyle, sleep, body fat, stress, training, and nutrition still matter. RESTED supports sleep quality and recovery, but sleep hygiene still matters. The stack helps. The plan still drives the outcome. Training Guidance The ARETE Stack should be paired with structured training and daily movement. Best training styles include: Resistance training Hypertrophy training Strength training Conditioning Cardio Step-based fat-loss phases Athletic training Cutting phases Recomp-focused training Train hard, but do not let the cut turn into reckless volume. When calories are lower, recovery matters more. The goal is to maintain training quality, keep protein high, stay hydrated, sleep well, and avoid burning yourself into the ground. Use the energy. Support the hormones. Protect the recovery. Stay consistent. Lifestyle Guidance For best results while using the ARETE Stack: Use as directed Assess stimulant tolerance Do not exceed recommended use Do not stack with other stimulant-heavy products Avoid late-day stimulant use Stay hydrated Maintain electrolyte intake Keep protein intake high Do not crash diet Prioritize sleep Use RESTED with a real sleep routine Train with structure Manage stress Be consistent Body composition rewards consistency. Not chaos. Individual Product Details For a deeper breakdown of each product, review the individual SHREDDED, ALPHA, and RESTED product pages. Those pages explain each formula in greater detail. This page explains why these three products are combined and how the full stack is designed to support body-composition execution, hormone-support nutrition, sleep quality, recovery, and day-to-night performance. Important Use Notice Use as directed. Do not exceed recommended use. This stack contains stimulant-based ingredients from SHREDDED. Caffeine and stimulant-based ingredients may cause sleeplessness, nervousness, irritability, rapid heartbeat, increased sweating, or other stimulant-related effects in sensitive users. Do not use if sensitive to caffeine, stimulants, sleep-support ingredients, hormone-support ingredients, or stimulant-like ingredients. Do not combine SHREDDED with other stimulant-heavy products, excessive caffeine, alcohol, recreational drugs, or products that may affect heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, mood, alertness, or tolerance. RESTED may cause drowsiness. Do not use before driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks that require alertness. Do not combine RESTED with alcohol, sedatives, sleep medications, or other products that may cause drowsiness unless directed by a qualified healthcare professional. If using other supplements that contain overlapping hormone-support ingredients, sleep-support ingredients, stimulant ingredients, or body-composition support ingredients, account for total daily intake. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use if you have or have had cardiovascular, blood pressure, anxiety, psychiatric, neurological, kidney, liver, endocrine, thyroid, metabolic, sleep-related, digestive, hormone-sensitive, or other medical concerns, or if you take prescription medications. Discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional if you experience adverse reactions. Final Note The ARETE Stack is built for one purpose: a more complete body-composition and performance-support system. SHREDDED brings the thermogenic energy, focus, appetite-control support, metabolism support, and body-composition execution lane. ALPHA supports natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, male performance, and hormone-support nutrition. RESTED supports relaxation, sleep quality, nighttime recovery, and next-day readiness. This is the stack for users who want energy during the day, hormone-support nutrition in the plan, and recovery support at night. Use it with structure. Control calories when fat loss is the goal. Keep protein high. Hydrate like it matters. Train with intent. Protect sleep. Recover like performance matters. Stay consistent. Suggested Use: SHREDDED-AF: Suggested maximum dose is 2 capsules per day. Based on each individual, this can be taken 2 capsules once a day or 1 capsule twice a day (a minimum of 6 hours apart). If you've never taken Shredded-AF before, to assess tolerance, we recommend starting with 1 capsule per day before progressing to 2 per day and then 2 at once. ALPHA-AF: On day one, take 1 capsule, on day two, take 2 capsules, and then take 3 capsules for the rest of the bottle. We suggest taking Alpha in the morning with a meal. For Andro cycles, we suggest taking Alpha-AF AFTER the completion of the cycle for PCT purposes. Can I take Shredded everyday? We suggest taking 1-2 days off per week (depending on individual tolerance) to allow your body a break from the potent stimulant and thermogenic formula found within Shredded-AF. How long can I use Shredded for? The human body is amazing at adapting. For maximum results we encourage our customers to use Shredded for 12 weeks; followed by a 4 week break. Can I combine Shredded with Amped, Charged, Focused, or PRE? No, due to the extreme potency of these products, none of our stimulant-based products can be combined. They must be spaced 6 to 8 hours apart. Can Shredded be taken as a pre-workout? Absolutely, this is quite common and very effective. Is Shredded safe for women? Yes, both men and women can take the Shredded thermogenic fat burner. Can Alpha be combined with other Steel products? Yes, ALPHA can be combined with ANY STEEL product. Can I take Alpha with the Andros to boost my T even more? Generally, we suggest using Alpha-AF after the completion of your Andro cycle for PCT purposes. If you are seeking to reach higher levels of conditioning you may use a partial dose of Alpha-AF in conjunction with your Andro cycle. I am worried about my estro, can I use Alpha during my cycles to combat the side effects? Yes, if you are very prone to estro conversion, you can use ALPHA our PCT supplement during your cycle. However, most of our users do not need on cycle therapy estro support. How is Alpha different than the Andros? Andros are DHEA precursors that go through a DHEA pathway conversion to achieve their effects, while Alpha uses herbs and other ingredients to boost our body's natural production of T. Do I have to take Alpha after a cycle of Andros? ALPHA is strongly encouraged post cycle therapy because ALPHA aids the body in balancing out natural levels and ensuring you can keep training and recovering at optimal levels, doing this allows you to still feel good and keep your new muscle gains. How long do I need to use Alpha? As a standalone supplement, generally suggest a maximum time of 12 weeks on, with a minimum of 4 weeks break in between. How long can I use Alpha? We advise taking a 4 week break from ALPHA after 3 months of use. FOR PCT purposes: 1 month cycle of Alpha is generally all that is required. Can women take Alpha? No. I am 20, will Alpha help me? If you are under the age of 21, we advise you to look at products such as our proteins, pre-workouts, and recovery range. The majority of men under the age of 21 do not need a natural T booster on their own. Anyone taking Andro's should be using Alpha as a PCT, regardless of age.
