description.html: What are "Pre-Workout" supplements? Pre-workouts explained: Everything you need to know before you hit the gym With bodybuilders, runners, and everyone in between looking for every training advantage they can get, the demand for cutting edge products continues to grow. In years past the only option athletes could utilize to get more out of their workouts was coffee, but today that has all changed because pre-workouts have become the go-to drink of choice for anyone looking to squeeze more out of their workouts. What are "Pre-Workout" supplements? Pre-Workout supplements such as creatine, amino-acids, caffeine, nitric oxide agents, and more. They generally come in powder form to be mixed as a delicious drink but many are also sold in pill form. Thanks to improvements in science todays pre-workouts can be fine tuned to achieve a wide variety of incredible physical and mental boosting results. The benefits of "Pre-workout supplements" In addition to improving VO2 max, pre-workouts have been shown to improve strength, focus, endurance, and mood. Who should use them? Healthy adults over 18 should be able to tolerate most pre-workouts well and see improvements in their athletic performance. However, pre-workouts aren’t for everyone. Those who are sensitive to caffeine or other stimulants may not tolerate pre-workouts well, especially if taken too late in the day. FAQs Q Can you stack pre-workouts? A Yes, but not with other stimulant based products. Our pre-workouts can be combined with ADABOLIC, Andro’s, ATP-Fusion. Q When should I take my pre-workout? A Take them 20 to 30 minutes before you exercise to see maximum benefits. Q Will pre-workouts affect my sleep? A While everyone reacts differently, it’s advised to avoid taking a pre-workout 6-8 hours before you go to sleep. Q Will they make me jittery? A Any pre-workout has the potential to make you jittery, but it really depends on how well you tolerate stimulants. We recommend you start with a 1/4 scoop to assess your tolerance.

description.html: For Andro Guide: Click Here Description Suggested Use Ingredients Lean Mass, Strength & Hardening Andro Stack The Lean and Hard Stack combines 1-ANDRO and 3-EPI-ANDRO in a streamlined two-product system built to support lean mass, strength, muscle density, hardness, definition, and vascularity. 1-ANDRO establishes the lean-mass and strength foundation. 3-EPI-ANDRO adds dry hardness, definition, and a sharper cosmetic finish. This is the focused cycle-only version of the stack. ALPHA is not included and must be purchased separately for post-cycle support. Built To Support Lean mass and strength Muscle density and hardness Dry physique support Definition and vascularity A tighter, sharper look Lean-mass, hardening, and recomp phases Users who want a focused two-Andro stack Stack Snapshot Included Products: 1-ANDRO 3-EPI-ANDRO Stack Type: Lean-mass, strength, and hardening Andro stack Primary Lane: Lean mass, strength, density, hardness, definition, and vascularity Best For: Users who want two complementary Andros without post-cycle support bundled into the purchase Why This Stack Works Each product has a clearly defined role. 1-ANDRO forms the lean-mass and strength foundation, supporting dry gains, power output, muscle density, and a harder overall look during a structured cycle. 3-EPI-ANDRO adds the dry-hardening lane, supporting muscle hardness, vascularity, definition, strength, and a tighter cosmetic finish. One product builds the foundation. The other hardens the result. Together, they create a focused Andro stack for users who want quality size, strength, density, and definition without moving into a larger multi-product cycle. Who This Stack Is For The Lean and Hard Stack is designed for users who want more than a single-product Andro cycle while keeping the plan focused and straightforward. Lean-Mass Phases For users focused on adding quality size and strength while maintaining a harder, more athletic look. Hardening Phases For users who want greater muscle density, hardness, vascularity, and definition. Recomp Phases For users working to improve body composition while supporting strength, lean tissue, and a tighter overall physique. Focused Andro Cycles For users who want two complementary Andros without jumping into one of Steel’s larger four- or five-product stacks. Newer Andro users should approach this stack conservatively. It is streamlined, but it is still an advanced hormone-pathway cycle. Choose the stack based on your goal, experience, training status, nutrition, recovery, tolerance, and overall health. More is not always better. Lean and Hard vs. Complete Lean and Hard Both stacks contain the same Andro combination: 1-ANDRO 3-EPI-ANDRO The difference is simple: Lean and Hard Stack: Includes the two Andro products only. Post-cycle support is purchased separately. Complete Lean and Hard Stack: Includes 1-ANDRO, 3-EPI-ANDRO, and ALPHA for the post-cycle phase. Choose the Complete version if you want the entire cycle-and-post-cycle system bundled together. Choose Lean and Hard if you already have ALPHA or prefer to handle post-cycle support separately. Nutrition and Training Guidance Run this stack with a plan. Support it with: High protein intake Goal-appropriate calories Strategic carbohydrates around training Adequate dietary fats Hydration and electrolytes Progressive resistance training Consistent sleep and recovery Hypertrophy training, strength training, powerbuilding, heavy compound lifting, and structured recomp phases all fit this stack well. Cardio can support conditioning and calorie expenditure, but resistance training should remain the foundation. The products support the plan. They do not replace it. Poor nutrition, inconsistent training, dehydration, and inadequate sleep will limit the result. Cycle and Post-Cycle Planning Steel Andros are designed for structured cycle-based use, not indefinite daily use. Most users organize Andro cycles around defined 4-week or 8-week phases. A 4-week cycle is the more conservative approach and may be better suited for users who are newer to structured Andro use or assessing their response for the first time. An 8-week cycle should be reserved for experienced users who understand their tolerance and can properly manage training, nutrition, hydration, recovery, and post-cycle support. Do not run Andros continuously or exceed label directions. ALPHA is not included in the Lean and Hard Stack. Post-cycle support should be purchased and planned before beginning the Andro phase. After completing the cycle, use ALPHA as directed and allow adequate time off before beginning another Andro cycle. Do not wait until the cycle is over to start thinking about what comes next. Lifestyle Guidance For best results: Avoid alcohol and recreational drugs Do not exceed recommended use Stay hydrated and maintain electrolyte intake Keep protein intake high Prioritize sleep and recovery Avoid crash dieting Avoid unnecessary stimulant abuse Follow the cycle with appropriate post-cycle support Allow adequate time off before beginning another Andro cycle Structure and consistency win. Individual Product Details For a complete breakdown of each formula, review the individual 1-ANDRO and 3-EPI-ANDRO product pages. Those pages explain each product in greater detail. This page explains why they are combined as a focused lean-mass, strength, and hardening system. Important Use Notice For adults 18 and older only. Do not use if pregnant, nursing, or trying to become pregnant. This stack contains hormone-pathway products. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use if you have or have had liver, kidney, cardiovascular, blood pressure, endocrine, cholesterol, prostate, hormone-sensitive, or other medical concerns, or if you take prescription medications. Use only as directed. Discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional if you experience an adverse reaction. Final Note The Lean and Hard Stack keeps the objective simple: build lean mass and strength while creating a harder, denser, and more defined physique. 1-ANDRO builds the foundation. 3-EPI-ANDRO sharpens the result. Train with intent. Eat with purpose. Run the cycle with structure. Plan your post-cycle support before you begin. Build lean. Get hard. Keep it focused. How do I take 3-EPI-Andro? Take 1 tablet in the morning on an empty stomach and a second tablet 10–12 hours later. For best absorption, wait approximately 30 minutes before eating after each serving. Continue daily, including rest days, throughout your cycle. Can I take multiple Andros together? Yes. If using multiple Andros, take one serving of each product together in the morning and again 10–12 hours later, following the same dosing schedule. Do I need liver support or on-cycle therapy? No additional liver support or on-cycle therapy is required. Post-cycle support is recommended after completing your cycle. What is 3-EPI-Andro designed to support? 3-EPI-Andro is commonly used by athletes focused on physique enhancement, body composition goals, and overall training performance. What can I stack with 3-EPI-Andro? 3-EPI-Andro can be combined with a variety of compatible performance, recovery, hydration, and nutrition supplements depending on your training goals. Should I take it with food? For optimal absorption, it is best taken on an empty stomach. However, it may still be effective when taken alongside a light meal if needed. How old do I need to be to use 3-EPI-Andro? 3-EPI-Andro is intended for healthy adults 18 years of age or older. Can women use 3-EPI-Andro? No. Due to the hormone-support nature of this product, it is not intended for women. How long should I wait before starting another cycle? A time-on/time-off approach is generally recommended. After completing a cycle, allow an appropriate recovery period before beginning another cycle. Can I use 3-EPI-Andro with other STEEL supplements? Yes. 3-EPI-Andro can be incorporated into a broader supplement program and may be used alongside compatible performance and recovery products. Can I drink alcohol while using 3-EPI-Andro? Alcohol consumption is not recommended during a cycle, as it may negatively affect recovery, training performance, and overall results. What should I do if I miss a dose? If you miss a serving, do not double your next dose. Simply continue with your normal schedule at the next planned serving. How long can I cycle 3-EPI-Andro? Most users choose either a 4-week or 8-week cycle. Post-cycle support should be used after completing the cycle. Suggested use - How do I take 1 Andro? Take 1 tablet of 1-Andro in the morning on an empty stomach. Ideally, you do not want to eat for 30-60 minutes, but 30 minutes is sufficient. 10-12 hours later, take 1 tablet of 1-Andro on an empty stomach. You are going to repeat this for 4 to 8 weeks, depending on how long you choose to run your cycle. If you are using multiple Andros, simply follow the twice per day dosing schedule, and take your Andros together. How do I take multiple Andros at the same time? You take multiple Andros the same way you take individual Andros. Take 1 tablet of each Andro upon waking up, without food. Ideally, you do not want to consume food for the following 30-60 minutes. 10-12 hours later, take 1 tablet of each Andro without food, ideally waiting 30-60 minutes before consuming food. Repeat this for the length of the cycle. Does 1 Andro require liver support or on cycle therapy? Neither liver support nor on-cycle therapy is required, however, you will need to utilize Alpha-AF for PCT purposes, once you have finished your Andro cycle. In short, what is the difference between all of the Andros products? 1-Andro - Lean Hard Gains 4-Andro - Muscle and Strength Gains 17a-Andro - Strength and Muscle Composition 19-Nor-Andro - Power and Competitive Drive 3-EPI-Andro - Fat Mobilization and Water Depletion 7,3-Andro - Fat Mobilization and Cortisol Management What are the side effects of 1 Andro? The side effects range greatly from person to person. Genetics, lifestyle, eating habits and other variables all contribute to the side effects or lack of side effects users experience. For most, Alpha is perfect for restoring the hormonal balance of the body and ensuring the user keeps the majority of their new muscle gains. What is good to stack with 1 Andro? To maximize results, we suggest using Rested-AF for higher sleep quality, muscle recovery, and cognitive function day-to-day. We also suggest products such as ADAbolic and ADA-Load for optimized nutrient partitioning, muscle hydration, and caloric efficiency. Does it matter if I take them with food? You have slightly better absorption of the Andros on an empty stomach, but they still are effective even when taken with a small meal. How old must I be to take 1 Andro? You must be at least 18 years old. However, we do advise people under the age of 21 to stick to effective mass builders such as Pumped and ADABOLIC. Can women take 1 Andro? No. How long do I have to come off of the 1 Andro muscle hardener before getting back on? We operate under a time-on/time-off policy. If you run Andros for 4 weeks, take 4 weeks off (Alpha-AF PCT can be used for the 4 weeks off). If you run Andros for 8 weeks, take 8 weeks off (4 week cycle of Alpha-AF + additional 4 week break off all T modulators). Can 1 Andro be taken with other Steel products like Shredded? 1-Andro can be taken with ALL Steel products. We suggest waiting to take Alpha-AF until after you have completed your Andro cycle for PCT purposes. Can I drink alcohol on 1 Andro? We do not advise drinking alcohol on Andros, mainly because when we consume alcohol we suppress testosterone and the conversion of the Andros into testosterone. Refer to Dr. Paul Henning's article that takes a deep dive into athletic performance and alcohol What do I do if I forget to take a dose? Do not double up, just take 1 Andro when you can, and get back to your initial regimen. How long can I cycle 1 Andro for? You can choose between a 4 week cycle, or an 8 week cycle. Regardless of which cycle you decide, ensure that you run Alpha-AF for PCT purposes afterwards. 8 week cycles generally only require 1 bottle of Alpha-AF for PCT What products can be paired with Andros? Andros can be taken alongside PRE, Charged, Amped, Adabolic, Hyperade, Pumped, NO7, ATP-Fusion, Rested, BCAAS, ADA-Load Protein(Veg, Whey, Whey ISOI) 3-EPI-ANDRO 7 hydroxy-dehydroxepiandrosterone 25mg, Epiandrosterone 100mg Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidylcholine, Hydroxpropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica. 1-ANDRO 1-DHEA Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidycholine, Hydroxpropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium, Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica, FD&C Red #40

description.html: What are Fat burner supplements? Fat burners a category of supplements that are designed to increase your body’s fat burning potential and energy expenditure, impede fat absorption, and speed fat loss. What are the benefits of fat burners? Fat burners help to enhance fat loss, boost energy, curb appetite and help your body burn more calories throughout the day. Who should use them? Anyone who is healthy and wants to get rid of stubborn belly fat. If you have been stuck at a plateau and are looking for something to melt the last bit of fat off your frame then this could be a simple addition that makes a huge difference for you. FAQs Q Can I eat whatever I want and see results using fat burners? A No. They aren’t magic pills. However, when combined with healthy food choices and regular exercise they can enhance your body’s fat loss and fat burning potential and you can see incredible results. Q How much extra weight could I lose using a fat burner? A Everyone is different and the results may vary for you as an individual, but the most effective way to utilize a fat burning supplement is to combine it with a rigorous exercise program and healthy eating. Q When is the best time of day to take a fat burner? A Because fat burners are stimulants they are best taken in the morning, this way your sleep won’t be affected from taking stimulants too close to bed time.

How old must I be to take this stack? We do not advise drinking alcohol on Andros, mainly because when we consume alcohol we suppress T levels and the conversion of the Andros into T. Alcohol taxes the liver which leads your body to put focus on regenerating the liver, thus taking away from the ability to focus on muscle repair or in other words, putting on muscle. PRE, Charged, It is advised to include Adabolic and HyperAde as part of your pre/intra/post workout stack, in order to further drive muscular gains and recovery. Does this stack contain any stimulants? No, this stack contains no stimulants. This stack can be paired with stimulant based products like; Focused, PRE, Charged and Amped. Side effects? Because everyone's body is different, it is impossible to say which individual is going to experience different effects. Due to our proper dosing and liposomal technology with the Andros, side effects are mitigated as much as possible. Following up your Andro cycle with Alpha-AF for PCT will further mitigate these risks, and help you to lock in your progress while restoring hormonal balance to your body. Do I need on-cycle therapy or liver support? With any of our Andros, on cycle support is not required. Our Andros are manufactured using liposomal technology, ensuring non-liver toxicity. 19-NOR-ANDRO Ingredients 19-NorDHEA Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidycholine, Hydroxpropyf-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium, Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica, Silver Color 1-ANDRO Ingredients 1-DHEA Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidycholine, Hydroxpropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium, Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica, FD&C Red #40 4-ANDRO Ingredients 4-DHEA Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidycholine, Hydroxpropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica, Black Color Product Video

description.html: What are Muscle Building supplements? Muscle building supplements are supplements designed to help improve physical performance during resistance training and stimulate muscle growth. Protein and creatine are great examples of this category of supplements. What are the benefits of taking muscle building supplements? They can help your body repair muscle damage done during resistance training faster and help you recover quicker. Who can take muscle building supplements? Anyone looking to improve their athletic performance and enhance their muscle growth. FAQs Q Can protein shakes be used as a meal replacement? A No. Supplements can be used to fill in the gaps of your daily nutrition, like a snack, but nothing can take the place of eating high quality healthy food every day. Q What is the recommended time to drink a protein shake? A They are great any time of day but most people use them post-workout was a quick way to refuel their muscles to aid recovery.
